data.name: Duhat
data.gender_notes: Duhat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Fruit of the tree of Zakkum
data.long_meaning: The name Duhat refers to the fruit of the tree of Zakkum mentioned in the Quran. This tree is described as having bitter and painful thorns, and its fruits are eaten by the people of Hell. The name is thus a reminder of the consequences of sin and the importance of living a righteous and obedient life. The name Duhat carries the meaning “Fruit of the tree of Zakkum” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Duhat usually hope their child will grow to embody fruit of the tree of zakkum and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the consequences of sin and the importance of living a righteous and obedient life.
data.etymology: Duhat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fruit of the tree of Zakkum.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Duhat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
